name: Pomelo

low.description: About 2-3 segments or 1/3 cup peeled flesh

siboNotes: Pomelo is well-tolerated in SIBO as it's naturally low FODMAP and citrus fruits are generally gentle on sensitive digestive systems.
preparationTips: Remove all white pith as it can be bitter and harder to digest
Eat fresh segments rather than juicing to maintain fiber benefits
Store peeled segments in refrigerator for up to 3 days
Choose heavy, firm fruits that yield slightly to pressure
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of potassium for heart health
Provides dietary fiber for digestive health
